معدات
Electro 
 Hydraulic system for Steam Turbine Control
 Speed Control Module SC. 2.3 (A12)
 Skada Plzen

Module is intended for the control of speed of the turbo set within its 
 complete working range.

The speed control module Sc 2.3 (A12) 
function to control the speed of turbo set within its complete working range:
 - Turning speed equal 70 RPM,
 - Heating speed equal 1200 RPM,
 - Phasing speed equal 3000 RPM.

This document outlines the testing procedure P1, 
which performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

The first draft 
initiated by eng. Ashraf Farid, tested by
 م. 
أشرف فريد في 20 مايو 2003، تمت مراجعته بواسطة مراقبة الجودة EDEPCo. م. عبد المنعم الامام يقبله المدير العام : م. علي عبد الوهاب، ووافق عليه 
م. عوض محمد فتحي؛ رئيس قطاع محطة كهرباء طلخا

A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should be carry the 
فئة السلامة المناسبة,

Safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work area, 
is required

Inject voltage equal desired speed according

in front control cabinet side no. JC01

If any measuring point not tracing (according 
 the circuit diagram) then change the bad Card.

Set push bottom (Hand / Automatic) on desired 
 speed to automatic on control panel. figure 1

Continue with increase injection volt slowly 
 with observation departure and correct value must be zero when value actually 
 of speed equal desired of speed the lamp of push Bottom H/A on
desired 
 speed will be light and system change to hand mode automatically.
